effect: The guard covers the drive, completing the whale carrier and all chapter goals.
reaction: The covered belt gives the finished construction a clear, practical detail.

mostWorthwhile.text: Fitting the two skids and turning the whale upright made their purpose visible in the finished construction.

leastWorthwhile.text: The second skid fitting was predictable after the first, though seeing the pair take shape was useful.

surprise.text: Nothing was especially surprising; the weight rail and counterweight came together as expected.

arbitrary.text: No action felt particularly arbitrary, though the counterweight's precise role was not explained.

continue.text: I would probably stop here: the construction was clear and satisfying to finish, but the choices were mostly prescribed. This text trial cannot tell me how the pictures or handling feel.
